strategies.name: Baseline
strategies.parameters: no command: starting settings kept

strategies.name: Low taxes
strategies.parameters: all three taxes halved; spending unchanged

strategies.name: High taxes
strategies.parameters: all three taxes +10 points; spending unchanged

strategies.name: Infrastructure-led growth
strategies.parameters: infrastructure 6% of GDP (3x); rest unchanged

strategies.name: Social welfare
strategies.parameters: social 18% of GDP (from 10%); rest unchanged

strategies.name: Military-first
strategies.parameters: military 8% of GDP (4x); rest unchanged

strategies.name: Austerity
strategies.parameters: all four spending categories cut by 30%; taxes unchanged (surpluses repay debt automatically)

strategies.name: Deficit-financed expansion
strategies.parameters: taxes halved; administration 14%, social 14%, military 3%, infrastructure 4%

strategies.name: Maximum taxation
strategies.parameters: all three taxes at the 70% limit

strategies.name: Maximum spending
strategies.parameters: all four categories at the 50%-of-GDP limit

strategies.name: Balanced growth
strategies.parameters: income tax +3 points; administration 11%, social 11%, infrastructure 4%

strategies.name: Borrow, then default
strategies.parameters: B08 until market access is lost (or week 52), then declare default and return to starting settings

strategies.parameters: declare default in week 26 from the baseline

strategies.parameters: default in week 26, social 18% from week 27

strategies.name: Welfare, then default
strategies.parameters: B05, then default in week 104

strategies.name: Repeated defaults
strategies.parameters: default in weeks 26, 52 and 78

strategies.parameters: taxes 35% / 20% / 35%; administration 9%, social 8% (surplus test)

strategies.name: Tax-financed infrastructure
strategies.parameters: infrastructure 6% and income tax +4 points

strategies.name: Infrastructure at saturation
strategies.parameters: infrastructure 3.6% (the share that already reaches the engine's infrastructure ceiling)

strategies.name: One category at the limit
strategies.parameters: social 50% of GDP; rest unchanged

strategies.name: Tax cut with spending cut

strategies.name: Maximum taxation for 8 weeks, then undo
strategies.parameters: B09 in weeks 2-9, starting settings from week 10

strategies.name: High taxes with spending cuts for 13 weeks, then undo
strategies.parameters: X05 in weeks 2-14, starting settings from week 15

strategies.name: Deficit expansion for a year, then undo
strategies.parameters: B08 in weeks 2-52, starting settings from week 53
